row:
Elite level Physiotherapy Treatment for elite individuals like you!  

Working to keep you moving!

Body Works Sports Physiotherapy was started by registered physiotherapist, educator and avid cyclist Dana Ranahan in 2009.

Focusing on sport and active living, she tailored her practice to help people realize their full potential and achieve their personal best, whether it is the high level athlete, weekend warrior or the mature athlete with a desire to maintain an active and healthy lifestyle.

With more than 35 years of collective experience the Body Works team is comprised of a group of highly educated and accomplished physiotherapists whose philosophy is to take the time to assess your whole body to determine the root cause of your problem and customize a treatment plan that works for you.
